rigtune.screen.title: RigTune
rigtune.goal.performance.tooltip: Favour frame rate: settings are picked as if your hardware were one tier lower.
rigtune.goal.balanced.tooltip: Settings that match your hardware tier.
rigtune.goal.quality.tooltip: Favour visuals: settings are picked as if your hardware were one tier higher.
rigtune.screen.benchmark.needs_world: Join a world (ideally singleplayer) to run the benchmark.
rigtune.toast.title: RigTune: %s suggestions
rigtune.toast.body: Press %s or open RigTune to review
rigtune.status.restart: Restart Minecraft to finish applying %s change(s).
rigtune.status.scan_failed: Could not analyse this system; see the log.
rigtune.status.benchmark_unavailable: The benchmark needs an open world.
rigtune.screen.discard.tooltip: Cancel the mod and Sodium changes waiting for a restart. Their downloads are kept as .rigtune-superseded files.
rigtune.status.discard_busy: RigTune's apply helper is busy; try again in a moment.
rigtune.status.discard_failed: Could not discard the pending changes; see the log.
rigtune.toast.abandoned.title: RigTune dropped %s change(s)
rigtune.toast.abandoned.body: They failed 3 times or the mod was installed another way. See config/rigtune/last-apply.json.
rigtune.toast.applied.title: RigTune applied %s change(s)
rigtune.toast.applied.body: Mod files and Sodium settings were updated.
rigtune.toast.failed.title: RigTune: %s of %s changes failed
rigtune.toast.leftover.title: RigTune: %s change(s) not applied
rigtune.toast.leftover.body: They'll be retried when you exit, or use Discard pending in RigTune.
rigtune.toast.busy.title: RigTune was still applying changes
rigtune.toast.busy.body: The game started before RigTune's helper finished. Restart Minecraft so every change takes effect.
rigtune.benchmark.title: Benchmark results
rigtune.benchmark.menu.title: Benchmark
rigtune.undo.busy: RigTune is still downloading; try again when it's done.
rigtune.undo.error: Could not work out what to undo; see the log.
rigtune.undo.nothing_possible: Nothing here can be undone; the reasons are listed.
rigtune.undo.status.busy: RigTune's apply helper is busy; try again in a moment.
rigtune.undo.status.done: Undone: %s now, %s after a restart, %s cancelled, %s skipped.
rigtune.undo.status.failed: Could not undo; see the log.
rigtune.undo.title: Undo RigTune changes
rigtune.undo.unavailable: Undo is unavailable: config/rigtune/history.json was written by a newer RigTune.
rigtune.benchmark.met: Render distance %s keeps 1%% lows at or above the target
rigtune.benchmark.missed: No tested render distance met the target; %s had the best 1%% lows
rigtune.benchmark.cancelled.title: RigTune benchmark cancelled
rigtune.benchmark.chart.title: Recent runs · %s
rigtune.benchmark.cost.dh: Distant Horizons off: 1%% lows %s, avg %s (a report only; nothing was changed)
rigtune.benchmark.cost.shaders: Shaders off: 1%% lows %s, avg %s (a report only; nothing was changed)
rigtune.benchmark.deadline: Stopped at the 5-minute limit; the remaining checks were skipped.
rigtune.benchmark.gain.none: Compared with before: no significant change
rigtune.benchmark.measured: Current settings: %s FPS average, %s FPS 1%% low
rigtune.benchmark.menu.duration: Tune takes up to 5 minutes, Measure about a minute. Esc cancels.
rigtune.benchmark.menu.intro: Tune finds the highest render distance (and, in singleplayer, simulation distance) that keeps your 1%% lows at the target. Measure records your current settings to compare before and after a change.
rigtune.benchmark.menu.measure_after.loc: Stand where you measured before: the location has to match.
rigtune.benchmark.menu.measure_after.non: Run Measure before first (same scene and Minecraft version).
rigtune.benchmark.menu.scene.benchmark_w: A fixed RigTune world, the same every time. Opens from the title screen.
rigtune.benchmark.menu.scene.current.hin: Runs where you stand, in your current world.
rigtune.benchmark.noisy: Results were noisy (%s spread): close background apps and retry.
rigtune.benchmark.refused.failed: The benchmark failed to start; see the log.
rigtune.benchmark.refused.leave_world: Leave your world first: the benchmark world opens from the title screen.
rigtune.benchmark.refused.restoring: Still restoring settings from an interrupted benchmark; try again in a moment.
rigtune.benchmark.refused.world_failed: The benchmark world could not be opened; see the log.
rigtune.benchmark.result: Result: avg %s FPS · 1%% low %s FPS · P99 %s ms · %s measurement(s)
rigtune.benchmark.saved_before: Saved as “before”. Apply your changes, then run Measure after.
rigtune.benchmark.world.failed.body: It could not be opened; see the log.
